items.description: Translation of police report from Spanish to English (68 lines)
items.rationale: Translating documents to substantiate the claim is excluded under 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f); this is not an indemnity for property.
These are working materials raised alongside an excluded translation charge, so they are excluded under 7.1.8(e) and (f).

items.description: Compensation for robbery damage (watch and cash)
items.rationale: Robbery under 2.3.1 away from home is covered, with 4.2.4 capping it at 5,000. The expensive watch is limited to the valuables per-item sub-limit of 2,500 (4.2.2, no valuables schedule), and the cash (over 800) to the means-of-payment sub-limit of 500 (4.2.3). That gives 3,000, less the 50 deductible (7.8) = 2,950.
Forwarding and shipping charges are excluded under 7.1.8(b).
